connectome_sign_rule: ACh +1, GABA -1, Glu -1, others no edges
engine_validation_network: Shiu et al. 2024 leaky integrate-and-fire on FlyWire v630
engine_validation_stimulus: 21 right sugar GRNs, 150 Hz Poisson, 30 trials of 1 s
engine_validation_slope_direction: engine rate regressed on reference rate (np.polyfit(ref, ours)), linear rates over neurons active in either run
flywire_sign_convention: Shiu et al. 'Excitatory x Connectivity' column (GABA/Glu negative, all else positive) for both v630 and v783 packs
malecns_gust_check_protocol: base model (w_syn 0.275, no adaptation, recurrent AL), 150 Hz Poisson, 30 trials of 1000 ms, seed 0, right-side GRNs
calib_persistence_protocol: base model (no adaptation, recurrent AL), Poisson 150 Hz for 300 ms then 700 ms off, 10 bins of 100 ms, rates averaged over B replicates (odour B=4, sugar B=16), seed 0
sweep_stimuli: odour: left ORN DM1/DM4/VA2; sugar: right LB3c+LB3b; looming: right LPLC2; all 150 Hz, 300 ms; base MaleCNS model with recurrent AL, w 0.275
criterion_C1_quiescence: ~0 active neurons in the last 200 ms of a 700-ms post-stimulus window for odour, sugar and looming
criterion_C2_responses_kept: sugar GRNs -> MN9 and LPLC2 -> DNp01 remain strongly driven
probe_protocol: base model (default Params: w 0.275, da 0, recurrent AL), 10 trials, 50-ms bins, seed 0
ffal_al_edge_definition: edges with both endpoints in classes ALPN/ALLN/ALIN/ALON or types ORN_/HRN_/TRN_ set to 0
ffal_calibration_protocol: PN drive 100 Hz for 300 ms then 700 ms off, B=8 replicates, seed 0, tau_a 1000 ms, w 0.275
vuln_rank_definition: rank/N in (0,1] of in+out |signed| contacts in the signed MaleCNS pack; ties broken by pack index (ascending bodyId, stable argsort), not averaged
path_eligible_rule: all neurons whose superclass does not contain 'sensory'
learn_compartment_rule: MBON type in a DAN type's compartment if it receives >= 10% of that type's synapses onto MBONs; map built from PAM and PPL1, but only PAM types are tested for activity
readout_mn9_definition: MN9 spikes over the 0.5-s sugar segment / 0.5 s / 2 neurons
readout_gf_definition: DNp01 spikes over the 0.3-s left looming segment / 0.3 s / 2 neurons; latency = first 1-ms bin with a spike
probe_steering_model: unmodified base model (da 0, recurrent AL, ORN drive) - not the paper model; no steering-DN test exists for the final model
arena_inside_plume_threshold: c > exp(-0.5) = 0.607, i.e. within 1 sigma (14 mm) of the source
arena_sugar_drive: 150 Hz x hunger, only on a food patch and grounded
arena_learned_valence: MBON valence (300 ms) minus the fly's naive valence at the current c_A and c_B (linear interpolation over probe levels 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0; held at the 1.0 value above)
arena_looming_drive: 150 Hz per threat to LPLC2+LC4 on the side facing the shadow (sin(bearing - heading) > 0 -> left)
arena_threat_rule: first at 6 s, then every 10 + 4U s (U uniform) until 2 s before the end; centres uniform within 18 mm of the arena centre; drawn once from default_rng(seed + 2), shared by all flies
joint_seeds_rule: fly seed = 5150 + 13 i; circuit stimulus rng 5151; threat rng 5152; probe rng 3; training rng 1; arena body rng per-fly xorshift from seed 5150
schematic_engine_box_text: Shiu et al. parameters / matches Brian2 (r = 0.9997) / + feedforward antennal lobe / + spike-frequency adaptation

_meaning.lif_w_syn: LIF parameter: Unitary synaptic weight used throughout (mV per contact), the published Shiu et al. value.
_meaning.lif_f_poi: LIF parameter: Poisson-input scaling: each input event adds f_poi * w_syn to v.
_meaning.lif_tau_a: LIF parameter: Default adaptation time constant in Params (ms); adaptation is off unless da > 0.
_meaning.lif_poisson_kick_mV: Membrane jump per Poisson input event (w_syn * f_poi, mV), about ten times the 7-mV rest-to-threshold gap. The project's scripts give their Poisson targets no refractory period (Brains.no_refractory), so a driven neuron near rest, in the absence of adaptation and synaptic input, spikes on the step after almost every event; an event that arrives in the step a spike is emitted is overwritten by the reset (lif_isolated_driven_spikes_per_event). This need not hold for the paper model's driven PNs, PAM and LPLC2/LC4, which are non-sensory, carry adaptation (da 1 mV, tau_a 1 s) and receive synaptic input: healthy driven PNs miss more events than an isolated neuron (pn_spikes_healthy_over_isolated_expectation), while healthy PAM neurons fire like one (pam_healthy_median_over_isolated_expectation).
_meaning.lif_isolated_driven_spikes_per_event: Engine test (lif.py on a one-neuron pack without edges, 256 replicates, 1 s from rest, no refractory period, tau_a 1 s): spikes per Poisson event at 150 Hz (odour/sugar/looming drive) and 100 Hz (PAM drive), without (da 0) and with the paper model's adaptation (da 1 mV). Losses without adaptation are events overwritten by the reset in a spike step; adaptation from rest adds 0.6 points of loss at 150 Hz and 0.0 at 100 Hz over 1 s.
_meaning.lif_adaptation_off_by_default: Brains initialises da to zeros, so every script that builds Brains without setting da (calibrate_wsyn, probe_circuits, validate_sugar_mn9, validate_engine_*) ran the unmodified base model without adaptation.
_meaning.lif_gate_refractory_input_default: Default engine setting: synaptic input arriving during the refractory period is discarded (the setting that matched Brian2 2.10.1); used by all paper simulations.
_meaning.model_tau_a_ms: Adaptation time constant of the paper model (ms).

_meaning.sweep_sugar_last200_by_setting: Neurons active 500-700 ms after sugar offset, per setting.
_meaning.sweep_loom_last200_by_setting: Neurons active 500-700 ms after looming offset, per setting.
_meaning.sweep_kc_frac_on_by_setting: Fraction of KCs active during the odour (union over 4 replicates), per setting.
_meaning.sweep_kc_mean_hz_on_by_setting: Mean KC rate during the odour (Hz), per setting.
_meaning.sweep_mn9_driven_hz_by_setting: Rate of the driven (left-annotated) MN9 under right sugar, 0-300 ms (Hz), per setting.
_meaning.sweep_gf_ipsi_hz_by_setting: Rate of the right (ipsilateral) DNp01 under right LPLC2, 0-300 ms (Hz), per setting.
_meaning.sweep_gf_contra_hz_by_setting: Rate of the left (contralateral) DNp01 under right LPLC2 (Hz), per setting.
_meaning.persist_noadapt_odour_sugar_loom_last200: Base MaleCNS model without adaptation: neurons still active 500-700 ms after offset of [odour, sugar, looming]; persistence is not only olfactory.
_meaning.persist_chosen_odour_sugar_loom_last200: Chosen setting (tau_a 1000 ms, da 1 mV), recurrent AL: neurons active 500-700 ms after offset of [odour, sugar, looming].
_meaning.persist_noadapt_odour_active_on: Neurons active during the 300-ms odour without adaptation.
_meaning.adapt_kc_mean_hz_noadapt_to_chosen: Mean KC rate during odour (Hz) without adaptation and at the chosen setting (recurrent AL, ORN drive).
_meaning.adapt_kc_frac_noadapt_to_chosen: KC fraction active during odour without adaptation and at the chosen setting (union over 4 replicates).
_meaning.adapt_cost_mn9_hz: Driven MN9 rate (Hz) without adaptation and at the chosen setting.
_meaning.adapt_cost_mn9_pct_change: Percent change of driven MN9 rate caused by the chosen adaptation.
_meaning.adapt_cost_gf_ipsi_hz: Ipsilateral (right) DNp01 rate (Hz) without adaptation and at the chosen setting.
_meaning.adapt_cost_gf_ipsi_pct_change: Percent change of ipsilateral DNp01 rate caused by the chosen adaptation.
_meaning.adapt_cost_gf_contra_pct_change: Percent change of contralateral DNp01 rate caused by the chosen adaptation.
_meaning.adapt_tau1000_da2_odour_last200_kcfrac_m: Stronger adaptation (tau_a 1000 ms, da 2 mV): [odour neurons active 500-700 ms after offset, KC fraction on, driven MN9 Hz, ipsilateral GF Hz].
_meaning.adapt_tau1000_da4_odour_last200_kcfrac_m: Stronger adaptation (tau_a 1000 ms, da 4 mV): [odour neurons active 500-700 ms after offset, KC fraction on, driven MN9 Hz, ipsilateral GF Hz].
_meaning.adapt_da4_mn9_pct_change: Percent change of driven MN9 at tau_a 1000 ms, da 4 mV (the only setting with zero odour persistence).
_meaning.sweep_kc_frac_range_adaptation_settings: Range of KC fraction across the 8 adaptation settings: none reaches the 5-20% criterion, so adaptation alone cannot make KCs sparse.
_meaning.sweep_settings_all_three_quiescent: Settings with zero persistence for odour, sugar and looming at once.
_meaning.sweep_settings_sugar_and_loom_quiescent: Settings with zero persistence after sugar and after looming.
_meaning.probe_protocol: Protocol of probe_circuits.py (not the paper model).
_meaning.probe_sugar_active_per_bin_stimulus_rang: Right LB3c+LB3b sugar, 150 Hz, 0-300 ms: min/max active neurons per 50-ms bin during the stimulus.
_meaning.probe_sugar_active_per_bin_post_offset_r: Same run, all 50-ms bins from offset to 700 ms after: min and max active neurons. The maximum is the first post-offset bin; after an initial drop the count plateaus with no decay toward rest (see the two keys below).
_meaning.probe_sugar_active_first_post_offset_bin: Active neurons in the first 50-ms bin after sugar offset (300-350 ms), and the fractional drop to the next bin (350-400 ms).
_meaning.probe_sugar_active_per_bin_post_offset_a: Active neurons per 50-ms bin from 350 ms to 1000 ms (50-700 ms after offset): a plateau with no decay toward rest.
_meaning.probe_sugar_total_rate_stimulus_range_hz: Summed rate over all neurons (Hz) per 50-ms bin during the sugar stimulus (first bin included).
_meaning.probe_sugar_total_rate_post_offset_range: Summed rate per 50-ms bin after sugar offset: flat, no decay.
_meaning.alt_drop_kckc_w0275_odour_last200: Odour neurons active 500-700 ms after offset with KC-KC synapses kept vs removed (w 0.275, no adaptation): removal does not end persistence. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); its keep-KC-KC w0.275 row equals the sweep_adaptation.py no-adaptation row exactly (kckc_w0275_keep_equals_sweep_da0_row), which supports left ORN DM1/DM4/VA2 odour, right sugar, right LPLC2, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window.
_meaning.alt_drop_kckc_w0275_kc_last200: KCs active 500-700 ms after offset with KC-KC kept vs removed. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); its keep-KC-KC w0.275 row equals the sweep_adaptation.py no-adaptation row exactly (kckc_w0275_keep_equals_sweep_da0_row), which supports left ORN DM1/DM4/VA2 odour, right sugar, right LPLC2, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window.
_meaning.alt_drop_kckc_w0275_kc_frac_on: KC fraction during odour after KC-KC removal (still above 20%). _meaning.alt_drop_sensory_input_w0275_odour_last2: Odour neurons active 500-700 ms after offset when input to sensory neurons is removed (w 0.275): persistence remains. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); stimuli, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window are assumed to follow sweep_adaptation.py, as for kckc_test.
_meaning.alt_drop_sensory_input_w0275_kc_last200_: KCs among those persistent neurons, and their share. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); stimuli, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window are assumed to follow sweep_adaptation.py, as for kckc_test.
_meaning.alt_drop_sensory_input_top_type: Largest persistent type after sensory-input removal and its count. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); stimuli, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window are assumed to follow sweep_adaptation.py, as for kckc_test.
_meaning.alt_drop_sensory_and_kckc_w0275_odour_la: Persistent odour neurons with both sensory input and KC-KC removed. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); stimuli, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window are assumed to follow sweep_adaptation.py, as for kckc_test.
_meaning.alt_lower_weight_w0157_odour_last200_kcf: Lower weight (0.157 mV): odour persistence remains (neurons active 500-700 ms after offset) while KC recruitment becomes sparse. Protocol inferred, not verified: no script in code/ writes this file (alt_tests_generating_scripts_found = 0); its keep-KC-KC w0.275 row equals the sweep_adaptation.py no-adaptation row exactly (kckc_w0275_keep_equals_sweep_da0_row), which supports left ORN DM1/DM4/VA2 odour, right sugar, right LPLC2, recurrent AL and the 500-700-ms window.
_meaning.alt_adaptation_only_da4: Adaptation alone at da 4 mV ends odour persistence but leaves KCs non-sparse and MN9 weak: [odour persistent neurons, KC fraction, MN9 Hz].
_meaning.alt_tests_generating_scripts_found: Number of scripts under code/ that write kckc_test.json, sensory_input_test.json or odor_intensity_sweep.csv (0 = not in the code release).
_meaning.intensity_sweep_da0_last200_range: odor_intensity_sweep.csv, da 0: range of the active_last200 column (neurons active in the last 200 ms after offset) over the 12 conditions. _meaning.intensity_sweep_n_orn_range: Range of stimulated ORNs in the intensity sweep (n_orn column).
_meaning.intensity_sweep_all_rows_include_DM1: Whether every intensity-sweep condition contains DM1 (glomerulus sets nested: a size/intensity test, not an odour-identity test).
_meaning.probe_odour_conditions: Unilateral ORN conditions in the probe (DM1+DM4+VA2, DA2, V on each side).
_meaning.probe_odour_n_active_range: Neurons active during the 300-ms ORN stimulus (t_off = 0, not persistence) across the six probe odours, base model.
_meaning.ffal_al_edge_definition: Definition of the removed antennal-lobe-internal chemical synapses (same mask in model.py).
_meaning.ffal_calibration_protocol: Protocol of test_ff_al.py (the feedforward calibration run); counts are per-replicate means truncated to int.
_meaning.n_stimulated_PN_odour_A: Uniglomerular PNs driven for odour A (DM1, DM4, VA2; both sides).
_meaning.n_stimulated_PN_odour_B: Uniglomerular PNs driven for odour B (DL5, DM2, VM2; both sides).
_meaning.stim_PN_odour_A_by_side: Odour A PNs (types matching the glomeruli) on the left and right (count check against n_PN_A).
_meaning.stim_PN_odour_B_by_side: Odour B PNs (types matching the glomeruli) on the left and right (count check against n_PN_B).
_meaning.ffal_kc_frac_A_B_da1: Calibration run, feedforward AL with adaptation: mean per-replicate KC fraction for odour A and odour B (B is below the 5% criterion).
_meaning.ffal_kc_frac_A_B_da0: Same without adaptation: adaptation raised, not lowered, KC recruitment in the feedforward AL.
_meaning.ffal_jaccard_da1_da0: KC-set Jaccard overlap between odours A and B (mean over replicates), with and without adaptation.
_meaning.ffal_last200_A_da1_da0: Neurons active 500-700 ms after odour-A offset (mean per replicate, int), with and without adaptation.
_meaning.ffal_mbon_hz_A_da1_da0: Mean MBON rate during odour A (Hz) with and without adaptation (feedforward AL).
_meaning.ffal_active_on_A_da1_da0: Neurons active during odour A with and without adaptation (feedforward AL).
_meaning.healthy_n: Healthy (stage 0, pan) flies of the severity series, the healthy reference for the four battery x4 designs (stage_curve, components, vulnerability, scope). The burden-matched comparison (exp2 battery.csv, map 'healthy'), the joint cohort (stage 0) and exp1 (per-fly healthy twins) each have their own healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_n_other_designs: Healthy flies of the designs with their own reference: exp2 battery.csv rows with map 'healthy' (analyze_exp2.py) and joint-cohort stage-0 flies (analyze_joint.py).
_meaning.protocol_paired_odour: Odour paired with PAM activation in every fly (no reciprocal or counterbalanced pairing in code/).
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_A_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median fraction of KCs firing >= 1 spike during 1-s odour A at 150 Hz.
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_A_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the fraction of KCs firing >= 1 spike during 1-s odour A at 150 Hz.
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_B_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median fraction of KCs firing >= 1 spike during 1-s odour B.
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_B_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the fraction of KCs firing >= 1 spike during 1-s odour B.
_meaning.healthy_valence_naive_A_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median naive MBON valence for odour A (signed sum of MBON rates, Hz).
_meaning.healthy_valence_naive_A_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the naive MBON valence for odour A (signed sum of MBON rates, Hz).
_meaning.healthy_valence_naive_B_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median naive MBON valence for odour B (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_valence_naive_B_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the naive MBON valence for odour B (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_AB_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median Jaccard overlap of the naive KC sets of odours A and B.
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_AB_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the Jaccard overlap of the naive KC sets of odours A and B.
_meaning.healthy_mn9_sugar_hz_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median MN9 rate (mean of the two MN9s) during 0.5-s bilateral sugar (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_mn9_sugar_hz_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the MN9 rate (mean of the two MN9s) during 0.5-s bilateral sugar (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_gf_loom_hz_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median giant-fibre rate (mean of both DNp01) during 0.3-s left looming (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_gf_loom_hz_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the giant-fibre rate (mean of both DNp01) during 0.3-s left looming (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_pam_pair_hz_median: Healthy flies (n=64): median mean over PAM types of the type-mean rate during pairing (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_pam_pair_hz_range: Min and max over healthy flies of the mean over PAM types of the type-mean rate during pairing (Hz).
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_B_over_A_ratio_of_median: Median KC fraction for odour B divided by that for odour A, healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_B_over_A_ci95: 95% bootstrap CI (flies resampled as pairs) of that ratio.
_meaning.healthy_n_flies_B_exceeds_A_kc: Healthy flies in which odour B recruited more KCs than odour A.
_meaning.healthy_kc_frac_A_vs_B_wilcoxon_p: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p, KC fraction A vs B within healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_valence_A_over_B_ratio_of_median: Median naive valence A divided by median naive valence B, healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_valence_A_vs_B_wilcoxon_p: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p, naive valence A vs B within healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_chance_median: Median per-fly Jaccard expected for independent KC sets of the observed sizes, pq/(p+q-pq).
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_obs_over_chance_media: Median per-fly ratio of observed to chance Jaccard: overlap is consistently about 21% above the independent-set expectation (see the keys below), not at chance; the low absolute overlap mostly reflects sparseness.
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_obs_over_chance_iqr_r: Per-fly observed/chance Jaccard ratio, healthy flies: [25th percentile, 75th percentile, min, max].
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_n_flies_above_chance: Healthy flies whose observed Jaccard exceeds the independent-set expectation, of all healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_kc_jaccard_obs_vs_chance_wilcoxo: Two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p, observed vs chance Jaccard within healthy flies.
_meaning.healthy_dvalence_A_B_LI_medians: Healthy medians of training change in valence for odour A, for odour B, and of the learning index (LI is almost entirely the paired-odour change).
_meaning.protocol_odour_rate_and_duration_battery: [Hz, ms] of PN drive in the full protocol and in the feedforward calibration run; the code records no reason for the difference.
_meaning.path_dth_max_mV: Threshold drop at full load (mV); v_th,i = -45 - dth_max * l_i.
_meaning.path_syn_loss_max: Fraction of output contacts lost at full load (binomial thinning, keep p = 1 - 0.6 l_i).
_meaning.path_death_max: Removal probability at full load (P = 0.5 l_i); a fixed default, fitted by no script.
_meaning.path_death_max_other_scripts: Scripts other than pathology.py that mention death_max (only to set it to 0.0 for the rule ablations).
_meaning.path_death_max_fitting_scripts: Scripts other than pathology.py that set death_max to any nonzero value (0 = the 0.5 default was never fitted or varied).
_meaning.vuln_rank_counts_al_internal_edges: The rank is computed in Connectome.__init__ on the full signed pack, before build_brains zeroes antennal-lobe-internal edges, so those edges count.
_meaning.vuln_rank_excludes_unsigned_outputs: Outputs of these neurons (count) and these edges are absent from the signed pack, so they count neither as the sender's outputs nor as the targets' inputs.
_meaning.vuln_rank_dnp01_L_R: Vulnerability percentile u of the left and right giant fibre (DNp01).
_meaning.vuln_rank_mn9_L_R: Vulnerability percentile u of the two MN9s in pack order (left-annotated, right-annotated).
_meaning.path_eligible_rule: Eligibility for load: stimulated non-sensory neurons (odour PNs, LPLC2/LC4, PAM) carry load and can be removed; a removed neuron has v_th = inf and cannot be driven by Poisson input.
_meaning.kc_dead_pct_s05_s06_s1: Mean percent of KCs removed at s = 0.5, 0.6 and 1.0 (severity series).
_meaning.kc_loss_17pct_crossing_s_interp: Severity at which mean KC removal reaches 17% by linear interpolation between s = 0.5 and 0.6 (the figures hard-code 0.55).
_meaning.fig_anchor_hardcoded: Severity anchor hard-coded in the figure script (read off the curve, not fitted).
_meaning.min_death_max_to_reach_17pct_kc_loss: Smallest death_max for which mean KC loss reaches 17% within s <= 1 (17% divided by the mean KC rank implied by 29.41% at s = 1 with death_max 0.5).
_meaning.dead_frac_s1_mean: Mean fraction of all neurons removed at s = 1 (below the 0.25 expected if every neuron carried load = rank, because sensory neurons carry none).
_meaning.stim_set_sizes_grn_loomL_pam: Battery stimulus sets: sugar GRNs LB3c+LB3b both sides, left LPLC2+LC4, all PAM neurons.
_meaning.stim_sets_sensory_flags: Whether each stimulated set is sensory (exempt from load): only the gustatory neurons are.
_meaning.pam_types_n_and_size_range: Number of PAM types and smallest/largest type size (neurons).
_meaning.ppl1_neurons_and_types: PPL1 neurons and types: they define compartments but are never tested for activity.
_meaning.n_kc_mbon: Kenyon cells and MBONs in the network.
_meaning.pn_readout_denominator_686_all_flies: PN_hz_A x 686 is an integer in every fly of the four x4 tables, so the PN readout averages over 686 ALPN-class neurons of which only 8 are driven.
_meaning.pn_spikes_healthy_median: Median total ALPN spikes (all 686 ALPN-class neurons) per healthy fly during 1-s odour A, against 8 x 150 = 1,200 expected Poisson events to the driven PNs.
_meaning.pn_spikes_healthy_range: Min and max total ALPN spikes per healthy fly during 1-s odour A.
_meaning.pn_spikes_healthy_over_isolated_expectat: Healthy median total ALPN spikes during odour A divided by the spikes 8 isolated driven neurons with the paper model's adaptation would fire (8 x 150 events x lif_isolated_driven_spikes_per_event['150Hz_da1'] = 1174). The numerator also contains non-driven ALPN spikes, so this is an upper bound for the driven PNs (odour A is the first protocol segment, so their adaptation starts from rest). A value below 1 means the driven PNs miss more events than adaptation alone explains; the extra loss comes from their synaptic input in the network, which the saved tables cannot separate.
_meaning.pam_healthy_median_over_isolated_expecta: Healthy median PAM_pair_hz divided by the rate of an isolated neuron driven at 100 Hz with the paper model's adaptation (100 x lif_isolated_driven_spikes_per_event['100Hz_da1']): healthy PAM neurons fire on about every event.
_meaning.pn_rate_s05_pct_healthy: Median PN_hz_A at s = 0.5 as % of the healthy median (severity series).
_meaning.pn_rate_s05_pct_healthy_ci95: 95% bootstrap CI of that percentage (flies resampled within groups, 4,000 resamples, seed _bootstrap_seed). Monte-Carlo unstable: over 20 other bootstrap seeds a bound varies over a range of up to 3.2 points (see the _mc_range key), so quote it to integers.
_meaning.pn_rate_s05_pct_healthy_ci95_mc_range: Same CI recomputed with seeds _bootstrap_seed + 1 to + 20 (4,000 resamples each): [[lowest, highest lower bound], [lowest, highest upper bound]] (% of healthy).
_meaning.pn_rate_s1_pct_healthy: Median PN_hz_A at s = 1 as % of the healthy median (severity series).
_meaning.pn_rate_s1_pct_healthy_ci95: 95% bootstrap CI of that percentage (flies resampled within groups, 4,000 resamples, seed _bootstrap_seed). Stable to within 1 point over 20 other bootstrap seeds (see the _mc_range key).
_meaning.pn_rate_s1_pct_healthy_ci95_mc_range: Same CI recomputed with seeds _bootstrap_seed + 1 to + 20 (4,000 resamples each): [[lowest, highest lower bound], [lowest, highest upper bound]] (% of healthy).
_meaning.pam_rate_s05_pct_healthy: Median PAM_pair_hz at s = 0.5 as % of the healthy median (severity series).
_meaning.pam_rate_s05_pct_healthy_ci95: 95% bootstrap CI of that percentage (flies resampled within groups, 4,000 resamples, seed _bootstrap_seed). Stable to within 1 point over 20 other bootstrap seeds (see the _mc_range key).
_meaning.pam_rate_s05_pct_healthy_ci95_mc_range: Same CI recomputed with seeds _bootstrap_seed + 1 to + 20 (4,000 resamples each): [[lowest, highest lower bound], [lowest, highest upper bound]] (% of healthy).
_meaning.pam_rate_s1_pct_healthy: Median PAM_pair_hz at s = 1 as % of the healthy median (severity series).
_meaning.pam_rate_s1_pct_healthy_ci95: 95% bootstrap CI of that percentage (flies resampled within groups, 4,000 resamples, seed _bootstrap_seed). Stable to within 1 point over 20 other bootstrap seeds (see the _mc_range key).
_meaning.pam_rate_s1_pct_healthy_ci95_mc_range: Same CI recomputed with seeds _bootstrap_seed + 1 to + 20 (4,000 resamples each): [[lowest, highest lower bound], [lowest, highest upper bound]] (% of healthy).
_meaning.pam_healthy_vs_s1_mannwhitney_p: Two-sided Mann-Whitney p, PAM rate during pairing, healthy vs s = 1.
_meaning.pam_pair_hz_min_all_x4_flies: Lowest fly-level PAM_pair_hz (mean over the 15 PAM types of each type's mean rate during pairing, removed neurons counting 0) in any fly of the four x4 designs. The 5-Hz gate of learn() acts on each type separately, and per-type rates are not saved, so these tables cannot exclude that a type's gate closed (e.g. 14 types at 67.6 Hz and one at 0 give the same mean).
_meaning.pam_pair_hz_min_all_x4_flies_fly: Fly with that lowest PAM_pair_hz: [design table, condition, fly seed].
_meaning.components_s1_pn_spikes_median_by_condit: Median PN spikes per fly at s = 1 by rule-ablation condition: the PN decline comes from neuron removal (death_only ~ all; synloss_only and hyper_only ~ healthy).
_meaning.components_s1_pam_hz_median_by_condition: Median PAM rate during pairing at s = 1 by rule-ablation condition.
_meaning.exp1_pn_rate_restored_fraction_by_stage: Within-fly fraction of the PN-rate deficit restored by restoring all removed neurons vs all synapses ([median, n flies with deficit > 5% of healthy]); ~1 vs ~0 = lost stimulus delivery.
_meaning.final_model_da_half_over_base_healthy: Final model, healthy twins of 12 flies (shortened protocol): median per-fly ratio of readouts with adaptation da halved (0.5 mV) to da 1 mV; adaptation sets KC recruitment, MN9 and whole-brain spikes more than KC rate.
_meaning.protocol_state_reset_calls_in_battery: Calls to Brains.reset_state() in assay_battery.py: 0, so v, g, adaptation current and delay buffer carry over between all protocol segments (reset happens once, at construction).
_meaning.protocol_joint_resets_after_circuit_assa: The joint cohort resets state after its circuit assays and before the naive-valence probe (comment: 'the circuit assays leave adaptation charged').
_meaning.protocol_arena_starts_from_reset_state: HouseNB.run() resets brain state (not weights) before the arena, i.e. after training and the memory test.
_meaning.protocol_residual_adaptation_after_gap: Fraction of the adaptation current left after a 1-s and a 2-s gap (exp(-gap/tau_a)), carried into the next segment.
_meaning.protocol_plasticity_applied_after_traini: learn() is called once, after pairing (1 s), 2-s gap, odour B (1 s) and 2-s gap; KC activity during pairing only decides which synapses change.
_meaning.protocol_pam_drive_hz: Poisson drive to every PAM neuron during pairing (Hz).
_meaning.protocol_stim_rates_hz: Poisson drive to odour PNs, sugar GRNs and looming LPLC2/LC4 (Hz).
_meaning.learn_dan_on_hz: A PAM type counts as active if its type-mean rate (removed neurons count as 0) during pairing reaches this rate (Hz).
_meaning.learn_eta_and_factor: Depression eta and resulting multiplicative factor on KC->MBON weights (binary: applied in full to every active compartment).
_meaning.learn_fraction_of_type_removed_to_close_: Fraction of a PAM type's neurons that must be removed before its mean (~99 Hz per surviving neuron) drops below the gate.
_meaning.learn_compartment_rule: Compartment definition and which DAN types gate plasticity.
_meaning.readout_mn9_definition: MN9 readout is the mean of both MN9s (right sugar drives only the left-annotated MN9 in the base model).
_meaning.probe_steering_dn_max_hz: Highest DNa01/DNa02 rate (Hz) over six unilateral ORN stimuli (150 Hz, 300 ms) in the base model with ORN input and recurrent AL; no consistent lateralisation.
_meaning.probe_steering_model: Which model the steering probe ran on.
_meaning.probe_loom_LPLC2_R_dnp01_L_R_hz: Base model, LPLC2_R at 150 Hz for 300 ms (91 neurons): left and right DNp01 rate during the stimulus (Hz).
_meaning.probe_loom_LC4_R_dnp01_L_R_hz: Base model, LC4_R at 150 Hz for 300 ms (55 neurons): left and right DNp01 rate during the stimulus (Hz).
_meaning.probe_loom_LC4_LPLC2_R_dnp01_L_R_hz: Base model, LC4_LPLC2_R at 150 Hz for 300 ms (146 neurons): left and right DNp01 rate during the stimulus (Hz).
_meaning.probe_loom_LPLC2_LR_dnp01_L_R_hz: Base model, LPLC2_LR at 150 Hz for 300 ms (185 neurons): left and right DNp01 rate during the stimulus (Hz).
_meaning.arena_odour_drive_bilateral: Arena odour drive goes to the uniglomerular PNs of both sides at one concentration (cx.upn has no side filter), so the brain receives no left-right odour difference; the gradient direction is given to the body controller.
_meaning.arena_plume_sigma_mm: Plume concentration c = exp(-d^2 / (2 sigma^2)): sigma is a Gaussian SD (mm), not a width.
_meaning.arena_inside_plume_threshold: Definition of 'time near trained odour' (time inside the plume of odour A).
_meaning.arena_pn_drive: Poisson drive to the odour's uniglomerular PNs (both sides).
_meaning.arena_hunger_feed_rate_per_s: Hunger decrease per second of feeding (hunger starts at 1, clipped to [0, 1]).
_meaning.arena_hunger_recover_per_s: Hunger recovery per second when not feeding.
_meaning.arena_feed_mn9_threshold_hz: MN9 rate (mean of two, last 100 ms) above which a grounded fly on food feeds.
_meaning.arena_body_step_ms: Body step (ms); the brain runs 100 steps of 0.1 ms per body step.
_meaning.arena_readout_windows_ms: Sliding windows of the arena readouts (MN9 rate, giant-fibre spike count for take-off, MBON valence for steering).
_meaning.arena_gf_spikes_for_takeoff: Giant-fibre spikes (both DNp01 pooled) within 30 ms that trigger a take-off.
_meaning.arena_steering_gain_rad_s: Steering gain: steer = gain x tanh(learned valence / v_scale) x sin(phi - heading), phi = direction of sum_o c_o (source_o - x); only while walking.
_meaning.arena_valence_scale_hz: Valence saturation scale v_scale (Hz) in the steering tanh.
_meaning.arena_heading_diffusion_rad_sqrt_s: Heading diffusion of the correlated random walk (rad/sqrt(s)).
_meaning.arena_jump_refractory_s: Minimum time between jumps (s); jumps include spontaneous GF-triggered ones (heading kept when no shadow).
_meaning.arena_jump_direction_noise_rad: SD of Gaussian noise added to the away-from-shadow jump direction (rad).
_meaning.arena_shadow_radius_mm_and_duration_s: Looming shadow grows linearly from 2 mm to shadow_rmax (mm) over shadow_dur (s).
_meaning.arena_threat_seen_margin_mm: A threat is 'encountered' (denominator of jumps per threat) if the fly is within shadow radius + 6 mm at any step, even if airborne; looming drive is given only when grounded.
_meaning.arena_start_disc_radius_frac: Flies start uniformly within a disc of 0.8 R with random heading and hunger 1.
_meaning.arena_wall_mm: Wall position (R - 1.5 mm); a fly crossing it is put back and turned toward the centre with N(0, 0.6 rad) noise.
_meaning.arena_naive_probe: Naive-valence probe: [concentration levels, ms per level, gap ms, rng seed]; PN drive 150 Hz x level, run after a state reset and before training.
_meaning.arena_pam_driven: PAM neurons receive no drive in the arena (only GRN, odour PN and LPLC2/LC4 inputs).
_meaning.arena_threats_n: Threats in the 120-s joint-cohort arena run.
_meaning.arena_threat_max_centre_dist_mm: Largest distance of a threat centre from the arena centre (mm).
_meaning.joint_seconds_seed_nflies: Joint cohort: arena duration (s), master seed, number of flies.
_meaning.joint_stage_list: Severity:count list of the joint cohort.
_meaning.joint_threats_seen_mean_median_min_max: Threats encountered per fly (of 10): mean, median, min, max.
_meaning.joint_flies_no_threat_seen: Flies that encountered no threat, so jumps per threat is undefined for them.
_meaning.joint_flies_pi_undefined: Flies that entered neither plume, so the preference index is undefined.
_meaning.cohort_totals_battery_stats: Flies per design in battery_stats.json (the four battery designs and the joint cohort, without the burden-matched comparison).
_meaning.cohort_exp2_flies: Flies of the burden-matched map comparison (exp2 battery rows).
_meaning.cohort_total_flies: Total simulated flies (total of battery_stats.json + exp2); exp1 re-simulates existing flies and adds none.
_meaning.schematic_hardcoded_fly_count: Fly count hard-coded in the 'Readouts' box of the model schematic of figure_common.py (not the published Fig 1A, which make_figures.py draws with the total above).
_meaning.figure_common_output_dir: Output directory set in figure_common.py (the scripts that import the module set their own).
_meaning.schematic_panel_c_is_illustration: Panel C of the model schematic of figure_common.py draws the line u, the line 1-u and 260 uniform random points ('rule illustration'), not model loads; real loads put sensory neurons at 0 and the antihub map is not 1-u.
_meaning.schematic_engine_box_text: Text of the engine box in the model schematic of figure_common.py: r = 0.9997 sits above the two MaleCNS extensions although it was obtained on FlyWire v630 with the base model.
